contea di ritrovamento: County of Herefordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CAES NER[VA TRAIAN] AVG GERM

Silver Denarius of Trajan (98-117 AD), minted between 101 and 102 AD. The obverse depicts a likeness of the head of Trajan facing right with laureate crown. The obverse inscription reads: IMP CAES NER[VA TRAIAN] AVG GERM. The reverse depicts a figure (Mars) walking right with a spear and trophy. The inscription reads: PM TRP COS [IIII PP]. References. Mattingly, H and Sydenham, E A: Roman Imperial Coinage 1936 Spink [pages: 248 vol: 2 ref: 52]
